blossoming-prosperity-gift-box.title: Prosperity in Bloom
blossoming-prosperity-gift-box.descriptionHtml:
Prosperity in Bloom is a CHARM VILLA gift set containing 18 Goldfish Tea Bags in a Paulownia wood box with a hand-embroidered fabric lid. Its fixed four-tea assortment brings together Rose Oolong, Ruby Black, Jin Xuan Oolong, and Oriental Beauty for a gift to share at celebrations and gatherings.

What is included

  • 9 Goldfish Tea Bags — Rose Oolong Tea
  • 3 Goldfish Tea Bags — Oriental Beauty Tea (White Tip Oolong)
  • 3 Goldfish Tea Bags — Ruby Black Tea (Red Jade / Ruby No.18)
  • 3 Goldfish Tea Bags — Jin Xuan Oolong Tea (Golden Lily)

Packaging

  • Paulownia wood box body with hand-embroidered fabric lid.
  • Box dimensions: L 11.0 in × W 7.5 in × H 3.5 in (length × width × height).
  • The lid features hand embroidery, adding texture and carefully worked detail to the gift presentation.

How to brew

Pour 150 mL (about 5 fl oz) of hot water at 95°C (203°F) into your cup. Tear the package fully open at the notch and lift out the Goldfish Tea Bag. Add it to the water, gently submerge it with a teaspoon or stirrer, then let it float. Steep for about 5 minutes. Use a clear glass cup to enjoy the goldfish’s shape.

winter-blossom-gift-box.title: Snowy Twilight
winter-blossom-gift-box.descriptionHtml:
Snowy Twilight is a CHARM VILLA gift set containing 12 Goldfish Tea Bags of your selected tea, presented in a Paulownia wood box with a tie-dyed fabric lid featuring hand embroidery. Inspired by the meeting of cherry blossoms and snow, the collection offers a quiet tea moment for yourself or someone special.

Story

As the last days of winter give way to early spring, we picture cherry blossoms opening across the landscape.

Where blossom meets snow, Snowy Twilight captures the quiet grace of that fleeting season. May it bring you the fresh, gentle beauty of spring’s first light.

Choose your tea

  • First Prize Rose Oolong Tea: 12 Goldfish Tea Bags of this tea per box.
  • Third Prize Oriental Beauty Tea: 12 Goldfish Tea Bags of this tea per box.

Packaging

  • Paulownia wood box with a tie-dyed fabric lid featuring hand embroidery.
  • Box dimensions: L 11.3 in × W 4.6 in × H 3.5 in (length × width × height).
  • The tie-dye process creates variations in color; each lid may differ from the product images.

How to brew

Pour 150 mL (about 5 fl oz) of hot water at 95°C (203°F) into your cup. Tear the package fully open at the notch and lift out the Goldfish Tea Bag. Add it to the water, gently submerge it with a teaspoon or stirrer, then let it float. Steep for about 5 minutes. Use a clear glass cup to enjoy the goldfish’s shape.

Product Notice

  • Prices are subject to change and will be adjusted based on the official pricing from the tea competitions (held twice a year).
  • Actual tie-dyed lid colors may differ from the product images.

The box is meticulously crafted from premium Paulownia wood, ensuring a stable yet light structure of understated luxury. Its most unique feature is the silk outer lid, painstakingly hand-dyed by master artisans. The gradient color on each piece is an objet d'art, an unparalleled masterpiece of artistic light and shadow, far surpassing mass-produced alternatives.
The Heritage

This exquisite box captures the ephemeral beauty of the transition from late winter to early spring—a precious moment of merging cherry blossoms and snow, where nature is poised to awaken. purple-butterfly-gift-box.descriptionHtml:
Sapphire Wings is a CHARM VILLA gift set containing 18 Goldfish Tea Bags of Second Prize Oriental Beauty Tea. A Paulownia wood box with a hand-embroidered fabric lid presents this single-tea selection in a butterfly-inspired gift collection.

Story

Each winter, Taiwan’s purple crow butterflies trace a violet river across the island’s skies.

Their dark wings, adorned with blue and white, shimmer between violet and sapphire as they turn in flight—like a constellation briefly brought within reach.

CHARM VILLA captures their graceful silhouettes in a gift collection of fine Oriental Beauty Tea awarded Second Prize at a tea competition. As you settle into a quiet cup, imagine butterflies dancing through the shade, weaving a fleeting moment of beauty to keep.

About Taiwan’s purple crow butterflies

Purple crow butterflies thrive in Taiwan’s warm landscapes. Recorded migration patterns include a northward journey in early spring, movement in late spring and early summer, and a southward journey in autumn to sheltered wintering valleys. Their great winter gatherings are often compared with those of monarch butterflies in Mexico.

Four purple crow species are commonly found in Taiwan today. Another, the Great Crow’s endemic Taiwanese subspecies, has not been seen for decades—a reminder of how much these delicate lives depend on their habitats. Along a migration route at Linnei, conservation measures include protective netting and temporary motorway lane closures to help butterflies cross safely.

The butterfly embroidered on the Sapphire Wings gift box is the Striped Blue Crow (Euploea mulciber), known in Chinese as 端紫斑蝶. Its forewings catch the light in brilliant blue-violet, while white spots and fine pale markings decorate its hindwings.

The outer box lid utilizes a hand-woven fabric crafted on a traditional loom, presenting a simple, textured weave of warp and weft. The Bespoke Reservation

This is an ultra-rare, bespoke-reservation treasure. Its inspiration is drawn from the magnificent annual migration of the Euploea butterfly in Taiwan, a slow-moving purple river in the sky. The iridescent blue-purple scales constantly shifting on the butterfly wings are like a miniature galaxy in the night sky, instantly captivating the observer. This box infuses this precious, fleeting, and irreplicable natural beauty into the deep, mellow charm of the top-tier Oriental Beauty Tea.

orchid-gift-box.title: Royal Orchid
orchid-gift-box.descriptionHtml:
Royal Orchid is a CHARM VILLA gift set containing 18 Goldfish Tea Bags of your selected tea, presented in a Paulownia wood box with a hand-embroidered fabric lid. The orchid-inspired collection offers a gift for celebrations and meaningful occasions. Choose your tea and a Gold or Pink lid.

Choose your tea

  • First Prize Rose Oolong Tea: 18 Goldfish Tea Bags of this tea per box.
  • Third Prize Oriental Beauty Tea: 18 Goldfish Tea Bags of this tea per box.

Packaging

  • Paulownia wood box with hand-embroidered fabric lid.
  • Lid options: Gold or Pink.
  • Box dimensions: L 11.0 in × W 7.5 in × H 3.5 in (length × width × height).
  • The lid features hand embroidery, adding texture and carefully worked detail to the gift presentation.

How to brew

Pour 150 mL (about 5 fl oz) of hot water at 95°C (203°F) into your cup. Tear the package fully open at the notch and lift out the Goldfish Tea Bag. Add it to the water, gently submerge it with a teaspoon or stirrer, then let it float. Steep for about 5 minutes. Use a clear glass cup to enjoy the goldfish’s shape.

Product Notice

  • Prices are subject to change and will be adjusted based on the official pricing from the tea competitions (held twice a year).

christmas-gift-box.descriptionHtml:
The CHARM VILLA Christmas Edition (12-count) contains 12 Goldfish Tea Bags in a Blue or Orange paper box with a Christmas lid with hand embroidery. Choose a single-tea selection of Rose Oolong or Oriental Beauty, or a four-tea mixed assortment for seasonal gifting.

Tea selections

  • Rose Oolong Tea: 12 Goldfish Tea Bags of Rose Oolong Tea.
  • Oriental Beauty Tea: 12 Goldfish Tea Bags of Oriental Beauty Tea (White Tip Oolong).
  • Mixed Teas: 3 Goldfish Tea Bags each of Rose Oolong Tea, Oriental Beauty Tea (White Tip Oolong), Ruby Black Tea (Red Jade / Ruby No.18), and Jin Xuan Oolong Tea (Golden Lily). Total: 12 tea bags.

Packaging

  • Blue or Orange paper box with a Christmas lid with hand embroidery.
  • The selected box color and tea selection identify your chosen variant.
  • The lid features hand embroidery, adding texture and carefully worked detail to the gift presentation.

How to brew

Pour 150 mL (about 5 fl oz) of hot water at 95°C (203°F) into your cup. Tear the package fully open at the notch and lift out the Goldfish Tea Bag. Add it to the water, gently submerge it with a teaspoon or stirrer, then let it float. Steep for about 5 minutes. Use a clear glass cup to enjoy the goldfish’s shape.
